title: Stuck Pipe (Differential Sticking) at 2832.0m
root_cause: Worked pipe with 60 klbs overpull and spotted acid soak pill to dissolve cake. Caused by high differential overbalance pressure against permeable Barail Sandstone.
mitigation_applied: Worked pipe with 60 klbs overpull and spotted acid soak pill to dissolve cake. Caused by high differential overbalance pressure against permeable Barail Sandstone.
source_document: Golden PDF / Historical Well Completion Report

title: High Pressure Gas Kick (Formation Influx) at 2460.0m
root_cause: Formation pore pressure (12.0 ppg equiv) exceeded active mud hydrostatic column resulting in gas influx. Shut-in well on annular preventer; recorded SIDPP and SICP, circulated out influx using Driller's Method with weighted kill mud.
mitigation_applied: Formation pore pressure (12.0 ppg equiv) exceeded active mud hydrostatic column resulting in gas influx. Shut-in well on annular preventer; recorded SIDPP and SICP, circulated out influx using Driller's Method with weighted kill mud.

title: Severe Lost Circulation at 1540.0m
root_cause: Pumped 40 bbl LCM pill with coarse nut plug and reduced pump rate to 350 gpm due to fluid breakout into depleted, micro-fractured reservoir sand.
mitigation_applied: Pumped 40 bbl LCM pill with coarse nut plug and reduced pump rate to 350 gpm due to fluid breakout into depleted, micro-fractured reservoir sand.
source_document: Golden PDF / Historical DDR Incident Record

title: Casing Window Tight Hole & Sticking at 2783.0m
root_cause: Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 2771-2783 m not making progress. POOH for bit/bha change got stuck while preparing to pull through window. Fight lost returns/tight hole. Successful in pulling through window. Finished POOH. Test bops.
mitigation_applied: Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 2771-2783 m not making progress. POOH for bit/bha change got stuck while preparing to pull through window. Fight lost returns/tight hole. Successful in pulling through window. Finished POOH. Test bops.

title: Reaming Mechanical Packoff & Sticking at 4130.0m
root_cause: Finished reaming from 4130m to 4139m to acquire better MWD log. Drilled from 4139m to 4250m. Circulated bottoms up and boosted riser. POOH for wiper trip. Pipe stuck at 4094m. Worked stuck pipe.
mitigation_applied: Finished reaming from 4130m to 4139m to acquire better MWD log. Drilled from 4139m to 4250m. Circulated bottoms up and boosted riser. POOH for wiper trip. Pipe stuck at 4094m. Worked stuck pipe.

title: Coring Assembly Reaming Sticking at 3680.0m
root_cause: RIH with coring assembly. While reaming down from 3680m string became stuck momentarily at 3772m and 3842m. POOH and racked backed coring assembly. P/u rotary drilling assembly. W. O. W.
mitigation_applied: RIH with coring assembly. While reaming down from 3680m string became stuck momentarily at 3772m and 3842m. POOH and racked backed coring assembly. P/u rotary drilling assembly. W. O. W.

title: Static Differential Logging Pipe Sticking at 4123.0m
root_cause: Operations suspended due to industrial action. Continued RIH with logging tools on drill pipe. Pipe stuck with logging tools at 4123m. Worked pipe. POOH with wireline.
mitigation_applied: Operations suspended due to industrial action. Continued RIH with logging tools on drill pipe. Pipe stuck with logging tools at 4123m. Worked pipe. POOH with wireline.

title: Casing Differential Sticking at 1389.0m
root_cause: Made up 18 3/4" casing. Attempted to RIH with casing negative casing was differential stuck. Displaced well from 1,40 SG mud to seawater and worked casing free. RIH with 20" casing to 1389 m MD and landed wellhead in conductor housing at 139,7 m MD. Cemented 20" casing, bumped plug and confirmed no backflow.
mitigation_applied: Made up 18 3/4" casing. Attempted to RIH with casing negative casing was differential stuck. Displaced well from 1,40 SG mud to seawater and worked casing free. RIH with 20" casing to 1389 m MD and landed wellhead in conductor housing at 139,7 m MD. Cemented 20" casing, bumped plug and confirmed no backflow.

title: Severe Total Lost Circulation in Cavernous Dolomite
root_cause: Encountered fractured and vuggy cavernous Bilara dolomite leading to sudden complete loss of returns (50 bbl/hr).
mitigation_applied: Spotted 60 bbl high-fluid-loss squeeze LCM pill with blended nut plug and reduced pump rate to 280 gpm.

title: HPHT Gas Influx with Rapid Pit Gain in Deepwater Turbidite
root_cause: Abnormal overpressure in micro-laminated Pliocene turbidite channel exceeded mud hydrostatic by 1.4 ppg.
mitigation_applied: Immediate space-out and BOP shut-in. Bullheaded 14.2 ppg kill mud into drillpipe and circulated bottoms up safely.
